category_title: Students with personal, social, or academic challenges who prefer work-based learning
scenario_title: Introducing core professional knowledge about physiology and diabetes
minimal_context: The student is in a social and health care training classroom being asked to read facts about human physiology and diabetes to prepare for a test.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today we are going to learn the facts about human physiology and diabetes to prepare for your tests. Please sit at your desks and read the first chapter on how the body processes sugar.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Do we really have to just sit and read this? I thought we were going to use that box of insulin pens and injection needles you have on the desk.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to cover the theory first. Please focus on the text in front of you.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: But this just feels like irrelevant information. My grandmother suffers from diabetes, and she just had to change her diet. I don't see why we need to memorize all these biology terms.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to know this for when you administer insulin later. Keep trying to read through it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pulls out cell phone) I have a hard time just to sit and take in all this reading when there's no clear explicit connection to the practical work. I'm just going to take photos of these different coloured pens instead.

TUTOR: You need to know this for when you administer insulin later. Keep trying to read through it.

STUDENT: (Pulls out cell phone) I have a hard time just to sit and take in all this reading when there's no clear explicit connection to the practical work. I'm just going to take photos of these different coloured pens instead.

task.learning_goal: Prepare them for their own tests and administering insulin

context.environment: Social and health care training college classroom
context.materials: Box of insulin 'pens', injection needles, blood glucose measuring equipment, cell phones
context.social_setting: Classroom with teacher Betinna and students

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When expected to learn facts about human physiology through traditional, cognitive-based teaching
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Have a hard time just to sit and take in
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Limited prerequisites for learning by means of traditional, cognitive-based teaching

behavior_patterns.condition: When lacking a clear explicit connection between school-based activities and practical work-based activities
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Can cause chaos for diverse reasons
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Not all of them motivated for schooling
